findings.finding: An upward FY core-OP revision at this H1 print is likely but already sits in the street number. Takeda has revised its forecast at the H1 print in each of the last four years. Q1 core OP of 358.9bn is 30.9% of the 1,160bn plan, against 321.8bn, or 27.4% of the final 1,172.5bn, a year earlier, when H1 reached 639.2bn (56%). H1 FX ran slightly favourable: USD about 158 against the 156 assumption, worth +2.39bn core OP per yen. Against that, consensus PBT of 290.5bn already sits 15% above the company's 252bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 revisions and the next-day move: Oct-2024 raise, +0.14% (2024-11-01); Oct-2025 cut (net profit 228->153bn, pipeline impairment), -2.44% (2025-10-31). The Jul-2026 Q1 held its guidance, -3.59% (2026-07-31). Daily bars from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/4502.T
findings.why_not_priced: The Q1 progress rate and the FX path are public, and the consensus already prices a raise. If the market had NOT priced a raise, consensus PBT would sit near the 252bn plan rather than at 290.5bn, and the stock would not be at an 8y8m high. What is left unpriced is only the size of the raise against the street and the H2 launch-cost phasing. This is a small positive tilt, not an edge.
findings.independence: The revision cadence comes from kabutan's revision history (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4502). The consensus-above-plan figure comes from kabuyoho (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=4502&cat=3). The H1 FY2025 comparison comes from https://assets-dam.takeda.com/image/upload/v1761806529/Global/Investor/Financial-Results/FY2025/Q2/qr2025_q2_er_jp.pdf. Four sources point the same way, but the conclusion rests on reading them together.

findings.finding: Every pipeline catalyst for the quarter is already public and in the price, and the stock goes into the print stretched. Public items: ORZEYFUL US approval (2026-08-06), MIMRYLO approval (2026-08-29), zasocitinib priority review (2026-09-14), and the ORZEYFUL Japan/China launch, which sent the stock +5% to an 8y8m high on 2026-10-15. Run-up is +9.5% over 20 days, with three broker target raises since September. The strategic roadmap is held back for the 2026-12-11 Capital Markets Day. The last two comparable prints were sold the next day (-2.44%, -3.59%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Next-day moves over the last 8 prints (Yahoo daily bars): +0.14, +0.69, -1.07, -2.23, -2.44, +1.73, +1.23, -3.59. That is 4 up and 4 down; the two most recent H1/Q1 prints with guidance held or cut both fell.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the baseline lean is already -0.315 from the run-up. Margin shorts outnumber longs (信用倍率 0.48), and the October rally coincides with a defensive rotation, the Nikkei down from 70,684 (10-06) to 62,190 (10-26). Both could support the stock through the print. If the run-up were fully priced as risk, the consensus target would not still sit above spot.
